caseName: New York Stock Exchange v. Legate
caseNameFull: New York Stock Exchange v. Legate and Legate v. Maloney, Receiver
attorneys: Marcien Jenckes and Richard Wait for petitioner in No. 633. Mark M. Horblit for petitioner in No. 645 and respondent in No. 633. Marcien Jenckes for respondent in No. 645.

opinions.text:
